name: @openclinxr/station-mouth-executor
purpose: Mouth-station executor: builds the seat problem from GLB bytes and applies a pinned solution to GLB bytes with receipt provenance (MADR 0061 stationRole executor).

exportSummaries.ApplyProvenance: Provenance the caller supplies with a solution.
exportSummaries.ApplyResult: Seated bytes plus the receipt note recording what ran.
exportSummaries.BuildProblemOptions: Options for buildProblem: the one operator-set target (mouth-tuning rung 4).
exportSummaries.Problem: Solver input: the unseated asset and the cue track it must satisfy.
exportSummaries.Solution: Solver output: scored frames plus the provenance the receipt records.
exportSummaries.apply: Apply a pinned solution to unseated GLB bytes.
exportSummaries.buildProblem: Build the solver input for unseated GLB bytes.
